notes.title: Another Pint's Brand New Announcement Trailer Is Out!
notes.content: [p]Hello nerds![/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to share our [b]brand new[/b] announcement trailer, fresh out of the oven![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="q1MUTk3SQrg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]To those of you who have been with us for a while now, pretend all of this is news, and you’ve never seen any announcement trailer before. To everyone else, welcome![/p][p]Another Pint is a systems-driven tavern management game where you’ll get to build and run your own tavern, manage staff, make and serve drinks, and more! Check in from time to time to see updates on development as we dive deeper into what makes Another Pint an absolute banger of a management game.[/p][p]Remember to wishlist the game because we would really like your money at some point in the future [b]👉👈[/b][/p][p]And if you’d like to chat with members of the team and see more, you can also join our [url="https://discord.gg/YgcyPbcjs7"]Discord[/url]![/p]
